reports.title: The New York Times Company Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Below is the Company’s guidance for revenues and adjusted operating costs for the fourth quarter of 2026 compared with the fourth quarter of 2025.

Digital-only subscription revenues | increase 12 - 15%
Total subscription revenues | increase 9 - 11%
Digital advertising revenues | increase high-single-to-low-double-digits
Total advertising revenues | increase mid-single-digits
Affiliate, licensing and other revenues | increase low-single-to-mid-single-digits
Adjusted operating costs | increase 6 - 8%
The Company expects the following on a pre-tax basis in 2026:
•Depreciation and amortization: approximately $85 million, which includes approximately $25-$30 million of acquired intangible assets amortization,
•Interest income and other, net: approximately $45-$50 million, and
